lines.label: Change
lines.note: Blood Frenzy: Briar breaks free from her pillory, turning berserk against the nearest enemy. She standard sight the target and gains ghosting, 60–120% bonus attack speed and 24–60% bonus movement speed, as well as empowering her basic attacks to deal 60–100% AD physical damage to enemies surrounding her target. This damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.

lines.label: Change

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Blood Frenzy ends early if there are no longer any nearby valid targets or Chilling Scream}} is cast. If Head Rush}} is cast on a non-champion, Briar will stop prioritizing champions during the frenzy. Blood Frenzy basic attack reset Briar's basic attack timer. Head Rush}} and Certain Death}} can be cast during the dash.
